# Art Boulle

> > Art Boulle creates bespoke luxury doors, gates, staircases, and architectural metalwork for high-end residential projects across North America.

Based in Toronto and serving clients throughout Canada and the United States, Art Boulle specializes in handcrafted solid wood doors, custom metal gates, and ornamental metalwork featuring premium materials like teak, mahogany, leather, and copper. Notable collections include the DUAL series and The Paris Collection by Cesa Design.

## Key Topics

- Custom luxury doors
- Architectural metalwork
- Solid wood craftsmanship
- Metal inlays and ornamental design
- Custom gates and entryways
- DUAL series
- Teak and mahogany doors
- Toronto luxury projects
- The Paris Collection
- Transitional and modern interior design
- Bespoke furniture and staircases
- Hand-stitched leather details
- Smart gate technology
- Bridalpath Toronto estates
- West Palm Beach and Florida projects

## Featured Projects

- [The Paris Collection - Modern, Luxury & Unique Architecture](https://artboulle.com/Projects/the-paris-collection): Modern luxury furniture collection by Cesa Design with premium materials
- [Scrolls in Cast](https://artboulle.com/Projects/scrolls-in-cast): DUAL series luxury door with metal inlays and solid wood craftsmanship
- [Noble Cuero](https://artboulle.com/Projects/noble-cuero): Hand-stitched leather door with copper inlays and custom mahogany pull
- [Equilibre](https://artboulle.com/Projects/equilibre): Custom spiral staircase with luxury metalwork and ornamental design
- [Bridalpath](https://artboulle.com/Projects/bridalpath): 2018 luxury estate gate project in Toronto's exclusive Bridalpath area
